user.title: Fledge
user.description: Choose the Nest thermostat running Fledge. It has to be connected to Home Assistant over MQTT first.

confirm.title: Fledge
confirm.description: A Nest thermostat running Fledge was found (serial {serial}). Put Home Assistant on its screen?

cards.title: What the thermostat shows
cards.description: Each device is a card on the thermostat, in this order (drag to reorder). Turn the ring to browse them, press to open one: a light dims, a switch switches, a thermostat sets its temperature, a speaker its volume.

data_description.entities: Lights (a light group works for a whole room), switches, fans, other thermostats and media players.
data_description.wake: What shows when you walk up to it, turn the ring or press it while its screen is dark.
data_description.wake_device: Wake straight into one of the devices above instead.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already set up.
abort.no_thermostats: No Nest running Fledge was found. Connect it to Home Assistant over MQTT first.
abort.not_fledge: This isn't a thermostat running Fledge.

thermostat_outdated.title: Update the thermostat's Fledge
thermostat_outdated.description: The Nest thermostat {serial} runs a Fledge build older than this integration needs, so some of its cards may not work. Install its update from the thermostat's update entity (Settings → Updates).
